title: Flux
summary: A small Swift state-management library with action-based reducers, asynchronous middleware and a test store.
content:
I developed Flux as a small Swift library for structuring application state and interactions. It separates synchronous state changes from asynchronous work.

Actions and middleware

Reducers update state in response to actions. Asynchronous middleware can return follow-up actions, keeping interactions explicit and testable.

Testing asynchronous flows

The accompanying test store supports checking dispatched and received actions and waiting for middleware tasks to finish with a bounded asynchronous finish operation. NotesToGo uses Flux to organize its editor features.
